 Jagatpuri.

 Sharma and Mr. Alok Gupta
Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
This matter has been received on transfer from the Court of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Dinesh Kumar Sharma who is not holding Court today.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.324/2017 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Jagatpuri on the ground that the parties have settled their dispute vide MoU dated 16th April, 2022 which is on record of this Court.
Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 are present in Court and duly identified by their respective counsels and the IO.
Petitioner No.2 is the mother of petitioner No.1 and is resident in USA and has given power of attorney to the petitioner No.1.
Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on 02nd March, 2017 and due to mutual disputes and differences the marriage has resulted in a divorce vide decree dated 16th August, 2022.
No child was born out of their wedlock.
The respondent No.2 states in Court that she has received all settlement amounts and there is nothing further to be complied with.

2. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.324/2017 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Jagatpuri and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
3. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
